title: EU Battery Digital Product Passport
description: JSON Schema for Battery Digital Product Passports under Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 (the Battery Regulation), aligned with Battery Pass Consortium content guidance v1.1 (Dec 2023). Applies to: LMT batteries, industrial batteries > 2 kWh, and electric vehicle batteries (the three DPP-mandated categories per Article 77). Portable and SLI batteries are excluded from DPP requirements and not modeled here. The full per-field regulatory mapping lives in regulatory_references.md alongside this file.

x-regulatory-source.regulation: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 12 July 2023 concerning batteries and waste batteries
x-regulatory-source.reference_document: Battery Pass Consortium — Battery Passport Content Guidance v1.1 (December 2023). NOTE: this version was superseded by DIN-DKE-SPEC 99100 in January 2025; field labels may have shifted slightly in newer versions. See regulatory_references.md for reconciliation status.

x-access-levels.public: Accessible to the general public per Annex XIII point 1
x-access-levels.notified-bodies: Accessible only to notified bodies, market surveillance authorities, and the European Commission per Annex XIII points 2 and 3
x-access-levels.legitimate-interest: Accessible to any natural or legal person with a legitimate interest per Annex XIII points 2 and 4

general_info.title: General battery and manufacturer information
general_info.description: Section 6.1 of Battery Pass guidance — Annex XIII point 1(a) referencing Annex VI Part A.

battery_passport_identification.title: Battery passport identification
battery_passport_identification.description: Unique identifier of the individual battery passport. Must comply with ISO/IEC 15459 (or equivalent) per Article 77(3). Linked to the QR code on the battery.

battery_identification.title: Battery identification
battery_identification.description: Identifies the individual battery via model + batch or serial number per Article 38(6).
battery_identification.x-regulatory-source: Annex XIII 1(a) → Annex VI Part A(1) → Article 38(6)

serial_number.description: Individual serial number — required if no batch_number or product_number is supplied.

batch_number.description: Production batch number — alternative to serial_number per Article 38(6).

manufacturer_identification.title: Manufacturer identification
manufacturer_identification.description: Identifies the battery manufacturer per Article 38(7) and Annex VI Part A(1). Manufacturer is defined in Article 3(33).
manufacturer_identification.x-regulatory-source: Annex VI Part A(1); Article 38(7); Article 3(33)

trade_name.description: Registered trade name or trademark, if any.

postal_address.description: Single postal address with contact point.

unique_operator_identifier.description: Unique operator identifier per ESPR Article 2(32) and Battery Reg Article 11(1). Examples: DUNS, GLN, EORI, BIC, LEI, national VAT.

responsible_economic_operator_identifica.title: Responsible economic operator identification
responsible_economic_operator_identifica.description: Voluntary attribute added by Battery Pass Consortium. The economic operator responsible for the passport per Article 77(4) — may differ from the manufacturer over the battery lifecycle.
responsible_economic_operator_identifica.x-regulatory-source: Battery Pass Consortium recommendation (not mandated by regulation); references Article 77(4)

manufacturing_place.title: Manufacturing place
manufacturing_place.description: Geographical location of the battery manufacturing facility per Annex VI Part A(3).
manufacturing_place.x-regulatory-source: Annex VI Part A(3); Annex XIII 1(a)

unique_facility_identifier.description: Per ESPR Article 2(33). Common examples: GLN, ISO-31661-1 country codes.

manufacturing_date.title: Manufacturing date
manufacturing_date.description: Month and year of battery manufacturing per Annex VI Part A(4). Format: ISO 8601 year-month (YYYY-MM).

battery_category.title: Battery category
battery_category.description: Intended use of the battery. DPP applies only to LMT, industrial > 2 kWh, and EV categories.

x-enum-labels-fr.LMT: Batterie pour moyens de transport légers
x-enum-labels-fr.INDUSTRIAL_STATIONARY_STORAGE_OVER_2KWH: Système de stockage d'énergie stationnaire (> 2 kWh)

battery_weight.title: Battery weight
battery_weight.description: Mass of the entire battery in kilograms per Annex VI Part A(5). Voluntary granular weights for modules/cells when defined at pack/module level.
battery_weight.x-regulatory-source: Annex VI Part A(5); Annex XIII 1(a)

module_kg.description: Voluntary — for batteries defined at pack or module level.

cell_kg.description: Voluntary — for batteries defined at cell level.

battery_status.title: Battery status
battery_status.description: Current status of the battery in its life cycle. Dynamic — must be updated by the economic operator.

compliance.title: Compliance, labels, certifications
compliance.description: Section 6.2 of Battery Pass guidance — Annex XIII point 1(q) and 1(r).

separate_collection_symbol_displayed.title: Separate collection symbol displayed
separate_collection_symbol_displayed.description: WEEE separate-collection symbol mandatory on all batteries from 18 August 2025.

cadmium_symbol_required.title: Cadmium symbol required (Cd > 0.002%)
cadmium_symbol_required.description: True if battery contains more than 0.002% cadmium by weight.

lead_symbol_required.title: Lead symbol required (Pb > 0.004%)
lead_symbol_required.description: True if battery contains more than 0.004% lead by weight.

labels_meaning.title: Meaning of labels and symbols
labels_meaning.description: Plain-language explanation of all labels/symbols on the battery. Must be in language(s) easily understood by end-users in the Member State where placed on the market.

eu_declaration_of_conformity_id.title: ID of EU declaration of conformity
eu_declaration_of_conformity_id.label_fr: Identifiant de la déclaration UE de conformité
eu_declaration_of_conformity_id.description: Identification number of the EU declaration of conformity drawn up per Article 18.

eu_declaration_of_conformity_url.title: URL of the signed EU declaration of conformity document
eu_declaration_of_conformity_url.label_fr: URL de la déclaration UE de conformité
eu_declaration_of_conformity_url.description: URL where the signed declaration document can be retrieved.

test_results_compliance_url.title: Test results compliance documentation
test_results_compliance_url.description: Test reports proving compliance per Articles 7-10 and 12-14, accessible to notified bodies and market surveillance authorities.

carbon_footprint.title: Battery carbon footprint
carbon_footprint.description: Section 6.3 of Battery Pass guidance — Article 7 + Annex II via Annex XIII 1(c). Required for EV batteries first, then industrial batteries > 2 kWh except those with exclusively external storage. NOT required for LMT batteries in the regulation timeline as of v1.1.
carbon_footprint.x-staged-application: EV batteries: declaration from Feb 2025; performance class from Aug 2026; max threshold from Feb 2028. Industrial batteries: similar timeline shifted later. See Figure 16 in Battery Pass guidance v1.1.

carbon_footprint_kg_co2e_per_kwh.title: Carbon footprint as declared (kg CO2e / kWh)
carbon_footprint_kg_co2e_per_kwh.label_fr: Empreinte carbone déclarée (kg éq. CO2 / kWh)
carbon_footprint_kg_co2e_per_kwh.description: Battery carbon footprint in kg CO2-equivalent per one kWh of total energy provided over expected service life.

carbon_footprint_per_lifecycle_stage_pct.title: Carbon footprint share per lifecycle stage (%)
carbon_footprint_per_lifecycle_stage_pct.label_fr: Empreinte carbone par étape du cycle de vie (%)
carbon_footprint_per_lifecycle_stage_pct.description: Share of total carbon footprint per lifecycle stage per Annex II point 4.
carbon_footprint_per_lifecycle_stage_pct.x-regulatory-source: Article 7(1e); Annex II(4) via Annex XIII 1(c)

raw_material_acquisition_pct.label_fr: Acquisition des matières premières et pré-traitement (%)

carbon_footprint_per_lifecycle_stage_pct.x-coherence-rule: raw_material_acquisition_pct + main_production_pct + distribution_pct + eol_recycling_pct should equal 100 (±0.5)

carbon_footprint_performance_class.title: Carbon footprint performance class
carbon_footprint_performance_class.label_fr: Classe de performance de l'empreinte carbone
carbon_footprint_performance_class.description: Performance class assigned by manufacturing plant per Article 7(2). Effective from 2026 onwards.

carbon_footprint_study_url.title: Link to carbon footprint study
carbon_footprint_study_url.label_fr: Lien vers l'étude de l'empreinte carbone
carbon_footprint_study_url.description: Web link to a public version of the study supporting the declared CF values.

supply_chain_due_diligence.title: Supply chain due diligence
supply_chain_due_diligence.description: Section 6.4 of Battery Pass guidance — Annex XIII 1(d). The due diligence report (per Article 52(3)) is the only mandatory supply chain attribute in the DPP. Voluntary additions per Article 53.

due_diligence_report_url.title: Due diligence report URL
due_diligence_report_url.label_fr: URL du rapport de diligence raisonnable
due_diligence_report_url.description: Public report covering supply chain due diligence policy, risk management plan, and summary of third-party verification.
due_diligence_report_url.x-applicability-threshold: Operators with net turnover < €40M may be exempt per Article 47

third_party_assurances.title: Third-party supply chain assurances
third_party_assurances.label_fr: Assurances tierces de la chaîne d'approvisionnement
third_party_assurances.description: Voluntary additions — certifications of recognized due diligence schemes per Article 53.

materials_composition.title: Battery materials and composition
materials_composition.description: Section 6.5 of Battery Pass guidance — Annex XIII 1(b) for public composition; Annex XIII 2(a) for restricted detailed composition.

battery_chemistry.title: Battery chemistry
battery_chemistry.description: Cathode and anode active material plus electrolyte material. Examples: 'Li-NMC/Carbon/LiPF6', 'Lithium-Nickel-Manganese-Cobalt/Carbon/Lithium hexafluorophosphate', or technology-only acronym (Li-ion, NaS, NiMH, SSB).
battery_chemistry.x-regulatory-source: Annex XIII 1(b); Annex VI Part A(7)

critical_raw_materials.title: Critical raw materials
critical_raw_materials.description: List of EU-classified critical raw materials present above 0.1% by weight in any battery (sub-)component. Reference: EU Critical Raw Materials Act (2023) — 34 materials.
critical_raw_materials.x-regulatory-source: Annex XIII 1(b); Annex VI Part A(10)

subcomponent.description: Where the material is found (cathode, anode, casing, etc.)

detailed_composition_url.title: Detailed cathode/anode/electrolyte composition (restricted)
detailed_composition_url.description: Detailed material composition data — restricted access. Typically managed via IMDS (automotive) for traceability.

hazardous_substances.title: Hazardous substances
hazardous_substances.description: Substances above 0.1% weight by weight that pose threats to human health or environment, classified per CLP Regulation. SVHCs (substances of very high concern) per REACH must be reported to SCIP database.
hazardous_substances.x-regulatory-source: Annex XIII 1(b); Annex VI Part A(8)

hazard_classes.description: CLP hazard classes/categories (e.g., H300, H301, H400).

substance_impact_statements.title: Impact of substances on environment, health, safety
substance_impact_statements.label_fr: Impact des substances sur l'environnement, la santé, la sécurité
substance_impact_statements.description: Statements describing impacts of contained substances per applicable hazard classes (e.g., REACH, GHS).

circularity.title: Circularity and resource efficiency
circularity.description: Section 6.6 of Battery Pass guidance. Mix of public attributes (recycled content, end-of-life info) and restricted (dismantling manuals, spare parts).

removal_manual_url.title: Manual for removal of the battery from the appliance
removal_manual_url.label_fr: Manuel de retrait de la batterie de l'appareil
removal_manual_url.description: URL to PDF manual covering disassembly sequences, fastening characteristics, tools required, risk warnings, safety measures.

disassembly_manual_url.title: Manual for disassembly and dismantling of the battery pack
disassembly_manual_url.label_fr: Manuel de démontage et de désassemblage du pack
disassembly_manual_url.description: URL to PDF manual including exploded diagrams, cell/module dimensions, replaceability, fastener characteristics, fillings/casing info, tools, safety measures.

spare_parts_url.title: Part numbers and contact details for spare parts
spare_parts_url.label_fr: Numéros de pièces et coordonnées des fournisseurs de pièces détachées
spare_parts_url.description: URL to PDF listing component part numbers and addresses (postal/email/web) of spare parts sources.

extinguishing_agent.title: Usable extinguishing agent
extinguishing_agent.description: Recommended extinguishing agent — should reference standard fire classes (A, B, C, D, K).

recycled_content.title: Recycled content shares
recycled_content.description: Pre- and post-consumer recycled content for cobalt, lithium, nickel, lead per Article 8 + Annex VIII.

renewable_content_share_pct.title: Renewable content share (%)
renewable_content_share_pct.description: Share of renewable content per Article 7(1b).

end_of_life_info.title: End-of-life information
end_of_life_info.description: Information about waste prevention, separate collection, take-back, repurposing, recycling — per Article 74.

end_user_role_text.description: Plain-text description of end-user role in waste prevention and separate collection.

collection_take_back_info_url.label_fr: Information sur la collecte et la reprise

performance_durability.title: Performance and durability
performance_durability.description: Section 6.7 of Battery Pass guidance — Article 10 + Annex IV/VII via Annex XIII 1(g)(h)(i)(j)(k)(l)(m)(n)(o). Static fields below are mandatory; dynamic fields require BMS and apply per category.

rated_capacity_ah.title: Rated capacity (Ah)
rated_capacity_ah.x-regulatory-source: Article 10(1); Annex IV Part A; Annex XIII 1(g)

voltage_v.title: Voltages
voltage_v.description: Minimal, nominal, and maximum voltage; with temperature ranges when relevant.

expected_lifetime_cycles.title: Expected battery lifetime (cycles)
expected_lifetime_cycles.description: Expected lifetime in cycles + the reference test used; calendar years also recommended.

c_rate_of_test.label_fr: Taux de C utilisé pour le test

warranty_calendar_life.title: Period for which the commercial warranty for the calendar life applies
warranty_calendar_life.label_fr: Période de garantie commerciale pour la durée de vie calendaire

dynamic_state_of_health.title: Dynamic battery state (BMS-equipped batteries only)
dynamic_state_of_health.description: Live state-of-health data per Article 14 + Annex VII. Updated by BMS during use phase. Battery Pass v1.1 categorizes these as 'dynamic' attributes.

time_charging_during_extreme_h.label_fr: Temps de charge en températures extrêmes (h)
